source.title: Fuel Cells and Hydrogen Joint Undertaking (FCH JU); Summary of experiment series E3.5

http_range_probe.note: Only archive metadata and the first tar headers were probed; the 11.3 GB archive was not downloaded.

reported_experiment_scope.physical_scope: elevated liquid-hydrogen spill/release, rainout and dispersion at the HSE Science and Research Centre Frith Valley site

not_eligible_for: gaseous high-pressure HRS station-to-vehicle full-loop validation
eligibility_assessment.exclusion_reason: The dataset uses liquid hydrogen release geometry and pressures outside the gaseous HRS fueling-loop domain and does not provide vehicle fill, cascade, compressor, precooler or dispenser-controller traces.

reproducible_next_step.protocol_requirement: Freeze the liquid-release model, inclusion criteria, channel mapping, unit conversions and primary metrics before opening numerical files.
reproducible_next_step.file_requirement: Download only a documented subset under data/public_validation/raw, retain the archive MD5, record the selected member-file hashes and preserve the CC BY-SA attribution.
reproducible_next_step.claim_boundary: Do not promote this record to the full-loop gate or report it as validation of the HRS controller.

claim_boundary: This recheck verifies that an independent public raw-data archive exists for liquid-hydrogen consequence and detector research. It does not close the independent gaseous station-to-vehicle validation gate and does not permit IJHE-level readiness claims by itself.
